description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Thailand Thailand financial institutions and specialized financial institutions result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this is a Bank of Thailand financial-institution calendar, not a universal Thai employee, government, employer, exchange or payment-settlement calendar. Bangkok-only, Islamic-bank and southern-branch conditions remain explicit and are not generalized.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: Thailand: 2027 substitution. | Thailand: Bangkok-only event remains conditional.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-02-22"} | {"date":"2026-10-16"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/thailand-financial-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/thailand-financial-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned Bank of Thailand 2026-2027 financial-institution coverage.

name: check_th_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Thailand financial institutions and specialized financial institutions

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: BOT_substitution_events_are_pinned; no new substitution is inferred

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Thailand Working Day
